newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort raises Slough.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kleinwort raises Slough.

text.p: Real estate group Slough Estates Plc was raised to a "hold" from a "sell" at Kleinwort Benson, market sources said on Monday.
The move comes after Slough last week posted a better-than-expected 14 percent rise in first-half pre-tax profit to 37.4 million stg, encouraging hopes for a sustained recovery in the sector.
Analysts at Kleinwort were not immediately available for comment.
The stock was down 1-1/2p at 246, after on Friday closing at its highest level since September 1994. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
